price_note: Each url is the shop page for that exact part, with shop_price in shop_currency for shop_pack_qty pieces; unit_price_eur is the price per piece in euros at the ECB reference rates of 2026-10-23 (1 EUR = 1.1193 USD = 0.83728 GBP = 1.5665 CAD). Every spec comes from the page in source_url, checked on the date in checked; fields named in estimated are not on that page. Motor thrust, current and power are the 100 % row of the maker's load table (bench). Prices move and shipping is extra; check before ordering. The 1S 2-inch reference build is the micro from Mediocre Nerd, Build a Micro FPV Drone for $59 (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4nRgEmdwtJo).

parts.name: 1103 15000KV (no-name)
parts.note: The no-name motor from the video, the same AliExpress listing: 4 x 1103 15000KV 1S-2S for 32.19 EUR (8.05 EUR each). 3.7 g is BetaFPV's figure for its 1103 15000KV; 50 g is a vendor's 1S full-throttle thrust on a Gemfan 1635-4 (40 mm). No efficiency is published; 2.0 g/W is an estimate for this class.
